verdict.rationale: Yubico ships its own programmatic surfaces for the key: the ykman CLI, described as offering full scriptable device management (applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info), plus .NET, Android, iOS and Python SDKs. Both the Authenticator GUI and ykman can read device info, but nothing documents a feature-for-feature match between the GUI and the programmatic interfaces. The fleet REST API covers only delivery, inventory and shipment, and no machine-readable API spec exists. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence of UI-to-API parity, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt), and independent hands-on corroboration that every GUI action is scriptable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
